messages:
alice: Heads-up: planning a midnight rolling reboot across us-west2 / eu-west3 / apac1 to apply NIC firmware + kernel patches. Window 00:00-04:00 UTC. Need rack cadence, KV cache warmup plan, tenant priority list, and a quick cost delta. Any objections?
ben: OK from oncall, only ask is cadence and blast radius. how many racks per wave?
carla: Propose 8-12 racks per wave depending on pool. Expect ~15m drain + evict + 10m reboot/cooldown per rack. With overlap we can do 3 waves per region in window.
dave: Product check — any customer-visible throttles or degraded perf? We should flag enterprise tenants.
alice: we will route priority tenants to dedicated fallbacks and keep streaming endpoints on fallback tier. minor throttling for noncritical internal jobs. we'll post customer comms for enterprise buckets.
carla: KV/prefix cache will be cold after drain. Plan: seed most-used prefixes from telemetry and run warmup jobs before returning capacity to service. warmup script (run from ops bastion):
```
# warmup prefixes into kvcache
python ops/warm_kvcache.py --region us-west2 --prefix-file /tmp/top_prefixes.txt --parallel 40
# sanity check
curl -sS http://localhost:9000/metrics | grep kv_cache_hits
```
ben: cost question — burst capacity for canaries / backfill? if we spin up ephemeral GPUs to absorb traffic what's the rough delta?
carla: rough calc: +120 ephemeral GPU-hours across regions (canaries + parallel backfill). At current pricing that's ~\"$4k\" for the window. Can cut by throttling noncritical batch jobs but that increases job lag.
alice: TL;DR: SLA risk low if we use fallbacks; cost ~4k if we avoid throttling.
dave: fine as long as we queue a post-mortem and customer comms. label any tenant affected so CS can triage.
ben: i'll update oncall runbook and add automated rollback hooks. Also please add a netlink check post-reboot: `check-netlink-health --region $REGION --timeout 5m`
carla: will run the preflight probes 2h prior: kernel-compat smoke tests + NIC sanity. If anything flakey, abort wave.
infra-bot: Maintenance scheduled by alice: https://redwood.ops/incidents/1749501234 (window 2025-02-15T00:00Z - 2025-02-15T04:00Z) :calendar:
alice: thanks — will publish customer comms by EOD and post runbook in the runbook channel. ping me if you want the prefix list. :thumbsup:
